```{r setup}
library(cehbio)
d <- read_report_data(params$pipeline, params$project, folder = params$data_folder)
t <- d$text
lab <- t$labels
dep <- params$deployment
info <- d$deployments[d$deployments$deployment_id == dep, ]
nights <- d$nights[d$nights$deployment_id == dep, ]
if (!"in_deployment" %in% names(nights)) nights$in_deployment <- TRUE
inside <- nights[as.logical(nights$in_deployment), ]
sp <- d$species[d$species$deployment_id == dep, ]
main_sp <- if (params$pipeline == "images") sp[sp$kind != "other insect", ] else sp
fmt <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
csv_link <- function(df, name, label) {
  b <- jsonlite::base64_enc(paste(utils::capture.output(utils::write.csv(df, row.names = FALSE)), collapse = "\n"))
  sprintf("<a class='button' download='%s' href='data:text/csv;base64,%s'>%s</a>", name, gsub("\n", "", b), label)
}
```

::: {.note}
`r t$methods$caveat`
:::

```{r nights-table}

```

### `r if (params$pipeline == "images") "Moth species" else "Species"`: the 20 most often recorded

```{r species, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=6.8}
p <- plot_species(d, dep)
if (!is.null(p)) p
```

```{r species-table}
top <- utils::head(main_sp[order(-main_sp$individuals), ], 20)
if (nrow(top)) {
  nm <- if ("common_name" %in% names(top)) ifelse(!is.na(top$common_name) & nzchar(top$common_name),
                                                  paste0(top$common_name, " (", top$taxon, ")"), top$taxon) else top$taxon
  knitr::kable(data.frame(species = nm, individuals = fmt(top$individuals), nights = top$nights,
                          first = top$first_night, last = top$last_night,
                          `mean score` = sprintf("%.2f", top$score_mean), check.names = FALSE),
               align = "lrrllr", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r species-csv, results="asis"}
if (nrow(main_sp)) cat(fmt(nrow(main_sp)), " in all. ",
                       csv_link(main_sp[order(-main_sp$individuals), ], paste0(dep, "_species.csv"),
                                "Download the full list (CSV)"))
```

## How this was done

```{r methods, results="asis"}
m <- t$methods
cat(m$how, "\n\n", m$unit, "\n\n", m$night, "\n\n", m$weather, m$moon, "\n\n")
if (length(m$models)) cat("Models used:\n\n", paste0("- ", m$models, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
if (length(m$citations)) cat("Please cite:\n\n", paste0("- ", m$citations, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
if (length(m$notes)) cat("<details><summary>Notes on how this report was made</summary>\n\n",
                         paste0("- ", m$notes, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n</details>\n\n")
cat("[", m$made_with, " Report made in R.]{.small}\n", sep = "")
```
